kyoto_kusou_complete.gf_detail: Ask. Wine-bar plates: marinated mushrooms, pâté, prosciutto sliced to order, cheese, quiche and cake; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kusou_complete.vegan_detail: Ask. Some vegetable plates (marinated mushrooms, sautéed bamboo shoots in butter, lotus root, pickles) alongside charcuterie and cheese; ingredients not described (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kusou_complete.hours_raw: 15:00–23:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; walk-ins possible early (Tabelog; December 2024; October 2026). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats, counter (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). The owner runs it alone, so dishes can take time (2024–2026 reviews). At the end of a narrow alley of small restaurants near Shijo-Karasuma, 294 m from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 30 June 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kusou_complete.notes: [Wine bar · Shijo-Karasuma, a one-person bar in an alley] At the end of a narrow alley of tiny restaurants near Shijo-Karasuma, a clean, dim counter in front of a big wine cellar, open from 3 p.m. The owner runs everything alone — pours, recommends and cooks — so settle in: prosciutto sliced to order, marinated mushrooms (¥700), cheese, quiche, seasonal plates such as butter-sautéed bamboo shoots. Bottles from about ¥5,000. PayPay but no cards; closed Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the bar and cooks alone
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 30 June 2022. Reviewers from December 2024 to May 2026 note the owner handles everything single-handed.
chef_bio.specialty: Wines by the glass and bottle; prosciutto sliced to order.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular on a fourth visit advises patience, since the owner does everything, and found the butter-sautéed bamboo shoots impossible to stop eating.
A February 2026 visitor loved a wine the owner recommended and tried to buy a bottle, but found it sold out everywhere online.

cultural_comfort.note: One-person bar, so be patient; PayPay but no cards.

kyoto_goichi_panino.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: every panino is on wheat bread; arancini and tiramisu on the side (official site).
kyoto_goichi_panino.vegan_detail: Ask. The vegetable panini (caponata, tomato and basil pesto, eggplant) all come with cheese on the menu; ask about leaving it out (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_goichi_panino.hours_raw: 11:30–19:30, Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Order at the counter after choosing by QR code; cashless only — no cash (Tabelog, original text; March 2026). 10 seats, plus three terrace tables where dogs are welcome (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Italian staff who speak Japanese; English menu on the site (2026 reviews; official site). Bright yellow front on Kawaramachi north of Sanjo, 174 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; June 2025). Opened 10 August 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_goichi_panino.notes: [Panini · Kyoto City Hall, a slice of Italy] A bright yellow Italian panino bar just north of Sanjo, run by Italian staff who chat in Japanese, where crusty, chewy bread is stuffed with mozzarella and prosciutto, pistachio pesto and mortadella, or porchetta with scamorza (¥1,800–2,400; half sizes too). Add arancini, tiramisu, a limonata or an Aperol. Order by QR code; cashless only; dogs welcome on the terrace. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 10 August 2024. Reviewers note Italian staff who speak fluent Japanese and a largely international clientele (2025–2026).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor back from Venice came for the Aperol, and found the ciabatta, cicchetti and tiramisu just as good.
An August 2026 diner who usually dislikes hard bread found this crust a challenge to bite but the more delicious for it.
A March 2026 diner found the roast pork about half what the picture showed and the komatsuna a little wilted.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; Italian staff; cashless only; dogs on the terrace.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_gion_nikutei_shin.gf_detail: Ask. Beef kaiseki and hitsumabushi with several sauces and a dashi to pour over the rice; the sauces are not described for gluten (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nikutei_shin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Omi-beef restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nikutei_shin.hours_raw: Dinner 18:00–23:00 daily (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30; courses by 21:00, à la carte after 21:00); lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) on weekends and holidays only; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations for seats; lunch is the hitsumabushi set chosen on the day (Tabelog). Counter courses carry a 5% service charge; dinner private rooms ¥1,100 per room (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 38 seats: 10 at the counter on the first floor; on the second, a two-seat private counter overlooking the garden and six private rooms (Tabelog; July 2026). Counter non-smoking; smoking allowed in private rooms at dinner; all non-smoking at lunch (Tabelog). Restroom on the first floor only (September 2026). Through a noren and a long passage in a machiya off Shinbashi-dori, 4 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_gion_nikutei_shin.notes: [Beef · Gion, Omi beef in a machiya] Through a noren and down a long passage off Shinbashi in Gion, a machiya serving Omi beef two ways. At weekend lunch it is hitsumabushi: beef over rice in a pot, eaten plain, with condiments, then as chazuke with dashi (about ¥2,000–4,000). At night, nine-course meat kaiseki in private rooms (¥14,300 plus room fee) or at the counter, where premium cuts cost extra. Book the garden-view second-floor counter early. Celebrations handled warmly.

chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read. Reviewers describe a machiya with private rooms, a live-kitchen counter and many guests from abroad (2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 couple celebrating a marriage registration that day were surprised at the end of the course with a small firework and a congratulatory message, and seen off at the door.
A September 2026 lunch guest who had booked the garden-view second-floor seat was shown to another room and waited about 20 minutes to be moved.
An October 2026 diner found chateaubriand a ¥6,500 supplement and thought it unsurprising for the price, while admiring the kintsugi-mended tableware.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園肉亭 新、牛料理・日本料理、東山区新橋通大和大路東入二丁目清本町366-2、祇園四条駅から徒歩4分、夜18:00〜23:00 (コースL.O.21:00)、土日祝は昼11:30〜15:00、不定休、昼はひつまぶし御膳、カウンターのコースはサービス料5%、夜の個室は1室1,100円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、38席 (1階カウンター10、2階の個室カウンター2、個室6)、分煙 (個室は喫煙可、昼は全席禁煙)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京町家、Omi 牛、個室コース9品14,300円、シャトーブリアンは6,500円追加、Omi 牛のひつまぶし御膳、ユッケ、残ったご飯をおにぎりに、金継ぎの器。

cultural_comfort.note: 5% service on counter courses; ¥1,100 private-room fee at dinner; book early for the garden counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_goodman_roaster.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee with baked goods — carrot cake, blueberry cheesecake, lemon and cream-cheese pound cake — and a coffee soft serve; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goodman_roaster.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee (Americano, pour-overs) suits; the cakes, soft serve, latte and flat white use dairy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goodman_roaster.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours and closures may change — check Instagram (Tabelog; official site). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; November 2026). Counter, table, bench and sofa seats and a terrace (Tabelog; September 2026). Roaster on site; buy beans and get a free cup (September 2026). Non-smoking; English menu; staff speak English (Tabelog; September 2026). Shijo-Nishinotoin, south and one block east (official site), next to a coin laundry; 3 min from Karasuma Stn per the site, 10 min per Tabelog. Opened 22 November 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_goodman_roaster.notes: [Café · Shijo-Nishinotoin, a roaster from Taipei] The Kyoto branch of a specialty roaster with two cafés in Taipei, roasting on site near Shijo-Nishinotoin. Choose a light or dark-roast Americano or a fruity single origin, or try Taiwanese Alishan coffee served in tea ware, with carrot cake or blueberry cheesecake. Spacious, with a terrace; a loud, cheerful welcome; full by 8:30 some mornings. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

roles: Founder 伊藤 篤臣 (Atsuomi Ito), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: GOODMAN ROASTER is a specialty coffee roaster with two shops in Taipei and one in Kyoto, roasting on Diedrich machines linked through Cropster data between Taipei and Kyoto, and working for three years with the Tsou people’s organic Alishan coffee farm on quality. The site’s message is signed 伊藤 篤臣 (Atsuomi Ito). Tabelog gives the opening as 22 November 2019.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Make time to do nothing” — good coffee as a route to a richer, more positive daily life (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 traveller ate breakfast here while waiting on the coin laundry next door.
An October 2026 regular found the light-roast Americano sold out, took the dark roast and liked it, but thought the coffee soft serve tasted a little artificial.
An October 2026 customer carried cake home without an ice pack and found the cream melted after ten minutes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: GOODMAN ROASTER、台北に2店舗・京都に1店舗のスペシャルティコーヒーロースター、伊藤 篤臣 (Atsuomi Ito) のメッセージ「なにもしない時間を作ってください」、Cropster と diedrich の焙煎機 (京都店は5キロ機)、茶器で出す手沖式の阿里山珈琲、Qグレーダー、京都店は下京区矢田町115-2 (四条西洞院下ル一筋目東入ル南側)、地下鉄烏丸駅から徒歩3分、営業時間は Instagram で確認、卸売。食べログ: 8:00〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、テラス、英語メニュー、2019年11月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 浅煎りと深煎りのアメリカーノ、エチオピア、アイスコーヒー760円、フラットホワイト、キャロットケーキ、ブルーベリーチーズケーキ、コーヒーソフト、豆を買うとコーヒー1杯無料、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; cash only; busy mornings.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_joys_table.gf_detail: Ask. Hamburg steaks with demi-glace or other sauces over butter rice, with soup and side dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_joys_table.vegan_detail: Ask. The mains are beef hamburg and egg omelettes; Tabelog mentions salad bowls and vegetable smoothies by day, and the soup is made from a Kyoto-vegetable broth (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_joys_table.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:00) and dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 20:30) daily; breakfast 8:00–11:00 (last order 10:00) Friday to Sunday; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; arrive on time with the whole party, or the table goes to others; no infants or strollers inside, and children order from the adult menu (Tabelog). Orders by smartphone after registering on LINE; self-service water; one drink per person (August and September 2026). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「無し」). 20 seats, including a small terrace; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and e-money (Tabelog). Queues at times (September 2026). 1 min from the Matsubara Kawaramachi bus stop, 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_joys_table.notes: [Yoshoku café · Kawaramachi Matsubara, the green omelette hamburg] A bright lemon-and-lime café near Kawaramachi Matsubara known for its omu-burg: a big hamburg under a soft omelette — plain with demi-glace, or green with komatsuna and Uji matcha — on butter rice, scattered with edible flowers, ¥2,500 as a set with soup and small plates. Order by phone via LINE; one drink each; queues at peak times. Breakfast Friday to Sunday; no strollers.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a dining café using Kyoto beef and Kyoto vegetables, with salad bowls and vegetable smoothies by day and A5 wagyu steak with Kyoto wine or craft beer at night; opened 1 March 2022. An October 2026 reviewer was told the edible flowers are grown organically in western Kyoto.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner liked the food but found the LINE smartphone ordering, self-service water and one-drink rule restrictive for the price.
An August 2026 diner found prices higher than expected and the regular size on the small side.
An October 2026 diner arrived at opening; four tables filled at once.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・ハンバーグ・ステーキ、下京区植松町716 シャイニービル小坂 1F、清水五条駅から徒歩5分、松原河原町バス停から1分、昼 11:30〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00)、夜 17:30〜21:30 (L.O. 20:30)、金土日は朝 8:00〜11:00 も、不定休、予約可 (時間厳守、全員そろってから入店)、乳幼児とベビーカーは入店不可、子どもも大人と同じメニュー、サービス料無し、20席 (テラス席あり)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、2022年3月1日オープン、京牛と京野菜のダイニングカフェ。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): Omu-burg rice2,500円 (プレーンとグリーン、京都の小松菜とUji の抹茶、エディブルフラワー)、チーズ+200円、塩レモン、九条ねぎソースのハンバーグ、LINE でスマホ注文、ワンドリンク制、水はセルフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order on your phone via LINE; one drink each; cards and IC cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and Instagram; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_konabeya_isakichi.gf_detail: Ask. Small hot pots in a dashi broth, with fried dishes such as chicken skin, flatfish and small potatoes (2024–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_konabeya_isakichi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every hot pot, even the yuba and soy-milk one, is cooked in Kyoto dashi (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_konabeya_isakichi.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00; closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised; a November 2025 diner booked a month ahead and found it full (Tabelog; November 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; November 2025). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two raised tables for 4; at a table everyone shares one burner and one kind of pot at a time (Tabelog; March and November 2025). The menu is on the wall without prices (March 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). In a narrow lane by Tatsumi Shrine, Gion Shirakawa; 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_konabeya_isakichi.notes: [Hot pot · Gion Shirakawa, small pots till 3 a.m.] A tiny counter in a lane by Tatsumi Shrine, over 30 years old, serving one-person hot pots in a gentle Kyoto dashi — yuba in soy milk that ends as fresh tofu, Kujo green onion with chicken, hamo in season — with obanzai like the much-praised okara. Open until 3:00, a favourite late stop. The owner cooks largely alone, so service can be slow when full. Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-cook (unnamed), running the shop largely alone (November 2025, October 2026)
chef_bio.background: A November 2024 reviewer says the restaurant has been open over 30 years; a February 2025 diner had known it for 20 years. Reviewers describe the owner cooking almost single-handed (November 2025, October 2026) and chatting with regulars; a November 2025 diner came after hearing it recommended on the TV show "Futtou Word 10".

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner on a full holiday weekend found the gaps between dishes far too long, and two items ordered never came.
An October 2026 regular says the owner may seem unfriendly but is a good person, and suggests helping by refilling drinks when the owner is busy.
A September 2024 diner liked the okara so much that there were second helpings and some to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鍋・日本料理・創作料理、東山区祇園花見小路新橋西入巽小路上ル、祇園四条駅から約400m、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、16席、カウンターと座敷、喫煙可。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年10月、英語): Tatsumi 神社の前の細い路地、30年以上、約15種の小鍋、湯葉と豆乳の鍋はにがりで豆腐に、九条ねぎ、鱧、おから、elevator (揚げと大根おろし)、品書きに値段なし、ほぼ一人で営む店主、テレビで紹介、提供が遅く注文が抜けたという声 (2025年11月)、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; read the menu on the wall; bring cash; be patient when it is full.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sashi_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi is dressed piece by piece with sauces such as garlic soy and natto, and there are fried dishes and sushi rolls (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sashi_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; obanzai and dishes use dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sashi_nijo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–22:30; Sat–Sun 15:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; usually full, so book ahead by phone (Tabelog; September 2026). 20 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Near Nijo Castle, 454 m from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 7 July 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sashi_nijo.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Nijo Castle, sashimi seasoned piece by piece] A busy neighbourhood izakaya near Nijo Castle where the sashimi comes without soy and wasabi — each slice has its own seasoning, like tuna with natto sauce or salt-seared swordfish — and the signature roll is buried in sea urchin. Add the changing obanzai, fried horse mackerel and seasonal sake picked to your taste. About ¥5,000–10,000. Book ahead; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2019 (Tabelog). An April 2026 visitor came on the recommendation of a Pontocho chef; reviewers praise the care in each dish and the seasonal sake (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasoned sashimi platter; namida uni roll.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, there for the uni sushi, wished the floor service were more attentive given the chefs’ effort, and was unsure about returning.
An August 2026 diner went back within a week and found the obanzai and sashimi platter already changed.
A May 2026 diner was asked about preferences before each sake was poured.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区西大黒町336-10、二条城前駅から454m、月火木金 17:00〜22:30、土日 15:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約可、20席、禁煙、カード・交通系IC・PayPay 可、2019年7月7日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 二条城の近く、醤油とわさびではなく一切れずつ味付けした刺身の盛り合わせ、名物の Namida Uni の巻き、鉄火巻き、おばんざいの盛り合わせ、鯵フライのパセリソース、季節の日本酒、いつも満席、ホールの接客に不満という声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; order à la carte; sake chosen to your taste; cards, IC and PayPay.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_fiorisca.gf_detail: Ask. Courses centre on handmade pasta — tagliolini, tagliatelle, ravioli, gnocchi — plus fried dough and baked sweets (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_fiorisca.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led courses, but with seafood, meat and cheese, e.g. a gorgonzola mousse and pork terrine (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fiorisca.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–21:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day bookings sometimes possible (Tabelog; October 2025). Lunch courses about ¥3,000–5,000; dinner courses under ¥9,000 to about ¥10,000; a 10-dish course with two drinks ¥9,800 via Ikkyu (2024–26 reviews). 15 seats, mainly a counter; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards, no e-money (Tabelog). Quiet residential street a few minutes north of Oike, 7 min from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 20 March 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_fiorisca.notes: [Italian · Karasuma Oike, a couple's counter of Kyoto vegetables] A small counter on a quiet street north of Oike, opened in 2012 and now run by a couple, cooking gentle, vegetable-led Italian with seafood and handmade pasta — a pure daikon soup, cauliflower blancmange, two pastas, then fish or meat. Lunch courses about ¥3,000–5,000, dinner around ¥9,000–10,000. One diner found the pasta portions small in the three-pasta course. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Run by a couple (October 2025 review); names not given
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 March 2012 (Tabelog). An October 2025 diner found the couple running the restaurant serving quickly and efficiently; a September 2026 regular came on the recommendation of a chef at a well-known Kyoto restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Vegetable and seafood courses; handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner found the pasta portions small in the three-pasta course, with gnocchi-like dishes counted as pasta.
A December 2024 host was grateful the restaurant took a small group late at night.
A September 2026 regular hopes it stays easy to book.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、中京区高倉二条下ル瓦町545 アビリティ高倉 1F、烏丸御池駅から徒歩7分、昼 12:00〜14:00・夜 18:00〜21:30、火曜休み、予約可、15席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可 (電子マネー不可)、2012年3月20日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 京野菜と魚介のコース、手打ちパスタ、夫婦で営む店 (2025年10月)、昼のコース約3,000〜5,000円、夜は9,000円前後、一休のプラン9,800円 (10品と2ドリンク)、パスタの量が少ないという声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course; counter seating; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026. The website on Tabelog (fiorisca.com) does not resolve.

kyoto_gion_danbata.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based courses with handmade pasta, bread, mapo sauce and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_danbata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dashi is katsuobushi and Rishiri kombu, and courses include fish and wagyu (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_danbata.hours_raw: Wed–Sun 12:00–15:00 (last order 13:00) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 19:00); closed every Monday and every other Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservation only. Tabelog states: "We do not accept reservations from foreign customers due to our limited English skills. In the unlikely event that a reservation is made, we will take the liberty of canceling it." Courses: lunch ¥10,000, dinner ¥15,000–18,000, tax included (Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says "なし" (its English says a fee may be added). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, 1 table for 4; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; BYO allowed; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). In a machiya down a narrow alley off Hanamikoji south of Shijo; 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_danbata.notes: [Genre-free courses · Gion off Hanamikoji] A ten-seat machiya counter where a husband-and-wife team cooks Japanese-rooted courses with French, Italian and Chinese touches, changing every two weeks with the solar terms. Lunch ¥10,000, dinner from ¥15,000. Note: the shop states on Tabelog that it does not accept bookings from foreign customers, because of limited English, and will cancel any that are made. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed in the sources), with a spouse who makes the desserts (2025–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 September 2018 (Tabelog). Per 2025–26 reviews: a couple runs the restaurant together — the chef cooks and the spouse makes the desserts (May 2025; May 2026); a September 2026 reviewer speaks of "the chefs" at the counter, so other staff are not ruled out.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: playful dishes that invite new flavours, reflecting the 24 solar terms.
chef_bio.specialty: Crisp-scaled amadai; rice dishes with refills.

anecdotes.text: On a solo birthday lunch in August 2025, the couple timed each dish to the diner's own pace.
A September 2026 regular came across town from Kitano Tenmangu just for lunch, and had seconds of the homemade bread.
A first-time June 2026 guest found everyone started at noon, but the pace was adjusted to each table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇をん 段ばた、イノベーティブ・フレンチ・イタリアン、東山区祇園町南側570-128、祇園四条駅から徒歩約6分、水〜日 12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 13:00)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 19:00)、毎週月曜と隔週火曜休み、完全予約制、英語が話せないため海外の客の予約は受けず、予約があった場合はキャンセルする、ランチ10,000円・ディナー15,000〜18,000円 (税込)、サービス料: なし、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル1)、2018年9月1日オープン、二十四節気で2週間ごとに替わるコース、上質な鰹節と Rishiri 昆布の出汁、フレンチ・イタリアン・中華の技法。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む、奥様のデザート、甘鯛の鱗焼き、手打ちパスタ、レモン卵炒飯、麻婆豆腐、ちりめんじゃこ、プリン、抹茶と練り切り。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog says the shop does not accept bookings from foreign customers (limited English) and cancels any made; reservation only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through September 2026. The official site (danbata.com) refused the connection on 2026-11-05.

kyoto_sashimi_maru.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, tempura, fried fish, gratin and spring rolls; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sashimi_maru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, wagyu and game (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sashimi_maru.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 15:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); 15:00–17:00 by advance booking only; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Service charge 3% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料3%". The food menu shows no prices; the drinks list does (December 2025; July 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards, IC cards, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). In "Momiji no Koji", a 100-year-old machiya alley of small restaurants; 8 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn, 10 min from Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_sashimi_maru.notes: [Seafood kappo · Momiji no Koji between Shijo and Gojo] Despite the casual name, an eight-seat counter in a century-old machiya alley serving kaiseki-level dishes à la carte — straw-smoked bonito, red-shrimp tempura, rock-oyster gratin, even green curry. The food menu has no prices; expect ¥8,000–15,000 plus 3% service. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; one cook per a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 October 2019 (Tabelog). Per the operator: in "Momiji no Koji", a renovated machiya over 100 years old, serving seasonal kaiseki of port-fresh seafood, black wagyu and game with donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 New Year's Eve diner found it "a bit nerve-wracking" that the food menu listed no prices.
Kept waiting in May 2026, a diner was given simmered bamboo shoots as an apology.
A September 2026 regular felt rushed with only one person cooking, and wished the dishes used fewer repeat ingredients.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京都さしみ丸、居酒屋・海鮮・天ぷら、下京区石不動之町682-7 もみじの小路S-3、清水五条駅から徒歩8分、月〜土 15:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、15:00〜17:00は事前予約のみ、日曜休み、サービス料3%、8席 (カウンター)、2019年10月16日オープン、築100年超の町家を改装した「もみじの小路」、漁港直送の魚介、黒毛和牛、ジビエ、土鍋ご飯、シャンパン6種。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 料理の品書きに値段がない、刺身の盛り合わせ、大海老の天ぷら、冷やし茶碗蒸し、マグロのフライ、岩牡蠣のグラタン、白子の春巻き、グリーンカレー、一人で調理。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the food menu; 3% service; book for 15:00–17:00.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_yakiyasai_isoya.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled vegetables with miso, ponzu and soy-based sauces, quesadillas and fried rice; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiyasai_isoya.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables are the focus, but most plates pair them with squid, pork, chicken, tuna, fish, cheese or a soy-milk dashimaki; ask what can be made without (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiyasai_isoya.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 daily (last order 22:30), closing days not fixed (Tabelog); the official site gives 17:00–23:00 every day. Bookings online through the official site or by phone; seat-only bookings (official site; Tabelog). Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料・チャージなし。". About 20 seats at a curved counter (November 2026); Tabelog lists smoking as allowed; JCB, AMEX and Diners; QR payments (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi south of Oike; 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiyasai_isoya.notes: [Grilled-vegetable izakaya · Kiyamachi by Kyoto City Hall] A stylish curved counter where seasonal vegetables from the owner's family farm are grilled on the teppan and paired with clever sauces — arugula with miso squid, Kamo eggplant with sweet miso, lotus root with saba-miso cream cheese — plus vegetable sours. About ¥3,000–6,000; no service charge. Open nightly.

roles: Operator: the 五十家 group (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: vegetables from 五十棲農園, described as the owner's family source, and partner farms. Reviewers call it a shop of "the Isoya group" with other sister restaurants (2026 reviews); a Tabelog review says the group runs seven shops in Kyoto, and our record kyoto_sumizumido_hachijo describes 炭棲堂 as "a new concept from the izakaya group 五十家". An October 2026 reviewer first came about ten years ago.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: "Let us grill seasonal vegetables for you."

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner liked the small portions, which made it easy to try many dishes, and the avocado sour.
An October 2026 visitor returned after about ten years, remembering the first visit.
A non-drinker in October 2026 ordered a soda of red shiso from Ohara.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yakiyasai-isoya.com): 焼野菜 五十家、中京区木屋町通御池下ル下丸屋町421-5 ラディーチェ・マツヤビル 1F、17:00〜23:00 (毎日)、五十棲農園の野菜、無限トマト (ツナ・大葉と柑橘ポン酢) 500円、よだれ鶏 (農園ハーブと自家製デュカ) 850円、豆乳だしまき750円、オンラインか電話で予約、席のみの予約。食べログ: 野菜料理・鉄板焼き、京都市役所前駅から徒歩1分、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、不定休、サービス料・チャージなし、喫煙可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): ルッコラとイカの味噌漬け、賀茂なすの甘味噌、九条ねぎと豚バラ、蓮根と鯖味噌クリームチーズ、大根の味噌田楽、締めの炒飯、野菜のサワー、約20席の曲線のカウンター、五十家グループ。

kyoto_relation_bistro.gf_detail: Ask. Bistro plates with sauces, gratin and baguette; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_relation_bistro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: terrine, steak, lamb, escargot and butter (2026 reviews).
kyoto_relation_bistro.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:30); Thu dinner only; closed Wednesday; lunch bookings until 13:00 (Tabelog). Popular — book; fish can sell out at lunch (2026 reviews). BYO wine at dinner, ¥1,000 per bottle (Tabelog). 16 seats: counter and tables; children welcome; non-smoking; cards, nanaco, iD, Rakuten Pay and au PAY (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi-dori south of Aneyakoji; 5 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_relation_bistro.notes: [French bistro · Sakaimachi near Karasuma-Oike] A neighbourhood bistro marking 25 years in 2026, loved for generous, cheap French cooking: steak lunch about ¥1,650, a huge chicken-liver terrine, escargot, and a ¥3,300 dinner prix-fixe. BYO wine ¥1,000 at dinner. Often full — book. Closed Wednesday; no lunch Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a bistro celebrating its 25th anniversary in 2026 and long loved by locals (August–September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A twelve-time regular got a booking only two days ahead for the 25th-anniversary year — August 2026.
A September 2026 couple sharing the dinner set had each dish split onto two plates.
The water kept coming, and an October 2026 lunch guest chatted on until closing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ルラション (RELATION)、フレンチ・ステーキ、中京区堺町通姉小路下ル大阪材木町687、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月火金土日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:30)、木曜は夜のみ、水曜休み、ランチ予約は13時まで、16席、子供可、禁煙、ワイン持ち込み可 (夜のみ、1本1,000円)。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 25周年、ステーキランチ1,600〜1,650円、鶏のテリーヌ (Daisen chicken) 990円、エスカルゴ、ボロネーゼとポテトグラタン、仔羊、ディナーセット3,300円、グラスワイン600円、ガトーショコラ。

kyoto_affinage_gion.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar whose food runs to quiche, naturally leavened bread, cheese, prosciutto, potage and braised beef cheek (2025–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_affinage_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheese, prosciutto, quiche and beef dishes (2025–2026 reviews); the fruit cocktails are plain fruit and spirits — ask.
kyoto_affinage_gion.hours_raw: Official site: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–01:00 (L.O. 0:00); closed Monday; bookings by phone (official site), also online on Tabelog — if online shows full, call (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners per Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Glass wine at a flat ¥3,500 (November 2025, May 2026), up from ¥1,500 (July 2026 regular); dishes from ¥500 (July 2026). Opened 11 March 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_affinage_gion.notes: [Wine bar · Gion Shirakawa, one-man counter till 1 am] A seven-seat counter cut from a single slab of rock, on the Shirakawa, where the owner, working alone, pours French wine at a flat ¥3,500 a glass and makes whole-fruit cocktails — melon, strawberry, apple — and surprisingly good food: quiche, cheese, beef cheek bourguignon. Regulars praise the gentle, attentive master and the music; a July 2026 regular regrets that the glass price rose from ¥1,500. Gion mamas drink here (October 2026). Closed Monday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yukinori Kojima (from the Instagram account yukinori_kojima_kyoto linked on the official site; reviews call the master Mr. Kojima; no kanji in a source)
roles: Owner and only staff (July 2026: "despite being run by a single person")
chef_bio.origin: From Aomori, per an April 2026 review ("A wine bar run by a proprietor from Aomori").
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a wine bar on the bank of the Gion Shirakawa serving Champagne and wine by the glass and cocktails of seasonal fruit; the name Affinage means "maturing" — the owner hopes the bar, the owner and the guests will mature over 10, 20, 30 years like a fine wine. Opened 11 March 2011 (Tabelog). A July 2026 regular says the set name "Coji Coji" comes from the master’s name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: a bar to ease the day’s tiredness and restore energy for tomorrow; 「マリアージュ（出会い）から アフィナージュ（熟成）へ」.
chef_bio.specialty: Whole-fruit cocktails; wine by the glass; quiche.

anecdotes.text: "I think one downside is that the price for glass wine has increased from JPY 1500 to JPY 3500 across the board." — July 2026, a regular on a fourth visit.
"It’s one of the bars frequented by the mamas of Gion." — October 2026.
An April 2026 guest booked the same day and came in at 10 pm after work for a strawberry cocktail, carrot soup and red wine.
A May 2025 guest came back after eight years for the five-course Kojikoji set and a melon-and-Champagne cocktail.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (affinage-kyoto.com): Affinage、祇園白川のほとりのワインバー、シャンパーニュとワインをグラスで、季節のフルーツのカクテル、店名は熟成の意味で、店も店主もお客様も10年、20年、30年と熟成していきたい、1日の疲れを癒し明日の元気を取り戻すバーを目指す、グラスワインは時々で変わる、カード可、店内全面禁煙、予約は電話、東山区花見小路通新門前上ル東側 花見会館汀館1F、火〜日・祝 17:00〜1:00 (0:00 L.O.)、月曜休み、店主の Instagram (yukinori_kojima_kyoto)。食べログ: ワインバー、東山区中之町244-1、7席、ネットで空きがなければ電話を、2011年3月11日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 一人で営業、青森出身の店主、一枚岩のカウンター、フルーツカクテル (苺、メロン、林檎)、グラスワインは一律3,500円 (以前は1,500円)、料理は500円から、チーズ盛り合わせ、キッシュ、天然酵母のパン、目の前で切る生ハム、自家製チーズケーキ、コジコジのセット5品、牛頬肉の赤ワイン煮、音楽、祇園のママたちが通う。

cultural_comfort.note: A seven-seat counter run by one person; book by phone, or call if online shows full.

kyoto_il_tesoro_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; courses centre on pasta (squid ink, cold crab, anago with Kujo leeks), three homemade breads and a pork cutlet (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_il_tesoro_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of duck, fish, pork spare ribs, cutlet, burrata and crab pasta (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_il_tesoro_sanjo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:45–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Wednesday and the first and third Thursdays. Bookings taken. 12 seats, counter and tables, up steep stairs (September 2025); non-smoking; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. A December 2025 regular says it moved here from Shijo-Karasuma.
kyoto_il_tesoro_sanjo.notes: [Italian · Sanjo-dori, up the stairs] Look for the Italian flag on Sanjo-dori and climb steep stairs to a twelve-seat room with an old coffee-house feel. Set lunches start with a lavish appetizer plate and three homemade breads, then a choice from a long pasta list — the cold crab pasta is the regulars’ pick — and mains like spare-rib confit or a crisp pork cutlet. Portions are big. A September 2025 diner found it generous but ordinary. Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog introduces a hidden Italian restaurant on the second floor of a building on Sanjo-dori, marked by an Italian flag. A December 2025 regular has followed it since it was at Shijo-Karasuma; a March 2025 diner likens the room to an old coffee house.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog introduction: Italian food for grown-ups, made with good ingredients.
chef_bio.specialty: Cold pasta; homemade breads; set lunch.

anecdotes.text: Asked what to order, the staff told a May 2025 diner that many regulars choose the cold pasta.
"Everything had a homemade touch and was made with care, but overall it felt quite ordinary." — September 2025.
A September 2024 diner’s friend was given a birthday plate on the house.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL TESORO (イル テゾーロ)、イタリアン・パスタ・ダイニングバー、中京区三条通柳馬場東入中之町6 三条有本ビル2F、月火木〜日 11:45〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)・18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜と第1・第3木曜休み、予約可、12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、ビルの2階の隠れ家、三条通のイタリア国旗が目印、良い食材の大人のイタリアン。口コミ (2024年6月〜2025年12月、英語): ランチ3,850円、前菜の盛り合わせ、自家製パン3種、冷製パスタ (蟹とオレンジ)、イカスミ (+440円)、穴子と九条ねぎ、京都産の Moti Pork のスペアリブのコンフィ、Yonezawa のポークのカツレツ、スズキのロースト、鹿肉、フルーツトマトとブッラータのカプレーゼ、量が多い、昔の喫茶店のような店内、急な階段、四条烏丸から移転、誕生日プレート、普通だったという声。

kyoto_gion_okaru.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon in a curry or ankake broth (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_okaru.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every broth is a dashi of mackerel, urume and bonito flakes with kombu (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_okaru.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Thu 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–02:00; Fri until 02:30; Sat until 03:00; Sun 11:00–15:00 only; hours may change. No reservations; shared tables at busy times (October 2026). 37 seats: tables and two tatami tables for six. Smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). No service charge listed on Tabelog. A large udon portion is +¥220, though not on the menu (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_okaru.notes: [Udon · Gion, open till 2–3 am] A long-standing Gion udon house that fills up after midnight with people ending a night out. The draw is cheese-and-meat curry udon — spicy at first, then rich with dashi — beside soft Kyoto-style kitsune udon and a winter ankake udon thickened with kudzu. Quick turnover; shared tables when busy. Cash only; smoking allowed after lunch. Sunday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog describes the ankake udon: a dashi from four kinds of katsuobushi — mackerel, urume and bonito among them — with fine kombu, thickened with kudzu without water and topped with grated ginger. An October 2026 diner first ate the cheese curry udon here over ten years ago; reviewers in 2026 call it a traditional place and describe it packed after midnight.

anecdotes.text: "Even after midnight, the place was packed." — October 2026.
An October 2026 visitor ended a 30-person office outing here for the cheese curry udon first eaten ten years before ("Sorry for the commotion!").
A September 2026 diner tried the konoha-don, made with mushrooms instead of chicken, and noted it is cash only.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都祇園 おかる、うどん・そば・食堂、東山区八坂新地富永町132、祇園四条駅7番出口から徒歩3分、月〜木 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜翌2:00、金は翌2:30まで、土は翌3:00まで、日 11:00〜15:00、予約不可、37席 (テーブルと6名の座敷2卓)、喫煙可 (ランチは禁煙)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、うどんの大盛りは220円増し (メニューになし)、あんかけうどんは鯖・うるめ・鰹など4種の削り節と昆布のだしを葛でとじ、おろし生姜をのせて680円。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): チーズ肉カレーうどん大盛り1,470円、チーズカレーきつねうどん、きつねうどん、鶏卵うどん、このは丼、深夜も満席、相席、回転が早い、現金のみ、10年以上前から通う。

kyoto_sanei_hamo.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; hamo courses include tempura and soy- or ponzu-seasoned dishes, and the winter guji course a fried dish in rice-flour crumbs (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sanei_hamo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamo, guji and soft-shell turtle courses, with a hamo-bone and kombu broth for the hot pot (official site).
kyoto_sanei_hamo.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:00), dinner 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 19:00); closed Monday; summer holiday 28 September–1 October 2026. Tabelog gives dinner L.O. 20:00. Bookings by phone or online. Official site: up to 15 seats downstairs, the tatami room currently closed; Tabelog lists 30 seats (8 counter, 8 table, tatami for 2–14). Non-smoking since November 2019 (official site); children welcome; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; official site). No service charge (Tabelog; Japanese original 「なし」). Hamo shabu for mail order or take-away May–November (Tabelog).
kyoto_sanei_hamo.notes: [Hamo kappou · Kawaramachi-Shijo, since 1934] A third-generation kappou down an alley off Kawaramachi, where the hamo is bone-cut only after you arrive and the hamo-shabu broth is a family recipe. Summer and autumn bring hamo courses — otoshi with plum, tempura, hot pot, pressed sushi — winter brings Wakasa guji and soft-shell turtle. Hamo shabu course ¥12,100. Busy since a July 2026 TV feature. One August 2026 guest wanted service to match the room and found the hand towels too strongly scented. Closed Monday.

roles: A family restaurant now in its third generation (official site: 三代続く); the owner is not named. A June 2026 diner writes of "the owner and his wife".
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1934 (Showa 9), with three generations of hamo technique and a hamo-shabu broth passed down in the family; the hamo is bone-cut and blanched only after guests arrive; the shabu broth is made daily from grilled hamo heads and bones with kombu and Kujo leeks; bamboo shoots fetched each morning from a farm under contract. The site says the shop was featured on Kansai TV on 30 July 2026, after which bookings flooded in for two months, and that hamo is at its fattest in October and November, not summer.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「あーこれが本当の鱧料理なんだ」 — to let guests experience real hamo cooking.
chef_bio.specialty: Hamo shabu; hamo otoshi; Wakasa guji course.

anecdotes.text: A former chef dining in June 2026 enjoyed the sound of the hamo bones being cut.
"The scent of the wet towels was surprisingly strong, almost overpowering the aroma of the food." — August 2026.
An October 2026 diner was told by the staff that autumn is the best time for hamo.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kappou-sanei.com): 京料理・鱧料理 三栄、昭和九年創業、三代続く本物の技と味、鱧しゃぶのスープは代々相伝、来店後に骨切りして湯引き、カウンターで割烹スタイル、テーブル席、鱧しゃぶコース12,100円、季節限定鱧旬菜御膳9品9,900円、グジづくしコース8品15,400円 (若狭ぐじ)、竹の子づくしコース9,900円、竹の子会席コース12,100円、ランチの蓮根饅頭御膳3,960円、10月・11月限定の炙り鱧の出汁茶漬け4,180円、鱧しゃぶの出汁は焼いた鱧の頭と背骨、昆布、九条ねぎ、2026年7月30日に関西テレビで紹介され予約が殺到、鱧は10月・11月が旬、9月28日〜10月1日は夏季休暇、昼11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:00)、夜17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 19:00)、月曜休み、一階席最大15名、お座敷は現在クローズ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2019年11月から全席禁煙。食べログ: 日本料理・すっぽん、下京区河原町通四条下ル稲荷町319、夜 L.O. 20:00、30席、サービス料なし、子供可、5月〜11月は鱧しゃぶの通販・持ち帰り。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 鱧の落とし、鱧の造り、照り焼き、天ぷら、鱧鍋、押し寿司、卵豆腐、湯葉、焼き鱧の胡瓜と茗荷、9,900円のコース、店主夫婦、昭和の雰囲気、サービスがもう少しという声、おしぼりの香りが強い。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses by season; book ahead, especially since the July 2026 TV feature.

kyoto_gion_sushi_taku.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the course pairs sushi with freshly fried tempura, and sushi is seasoned with soy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_sushi_taku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi, tempura and Kobe-beef course (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_sushi_taku.hours_raw: Two dinner seatings daily: 17:30–19:30 (last order 19:00) and 20:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed 31 December 2026–4 January 2027 (Tabelog). Bookings cancelled automatically after 15 minutes late without notice (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％). 14 seats: a white-wood counter of 6 and tables; non-smoking; cards, UnionPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog; October 2026). Staff explain dishes in several languages, including Chinese (October 2026). On the 1st floor of SAKIZO花見小路ビル on Hanamikoji; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sushi_taku.notes: [Sushi · Gion, sushi and tempura on Hanamikoji] A six-seat white-wood counter on Hanamikoji serving one generous course (about ¥12,000) that mixes Edomae sushi with freshly fried tempura: otoro on black squid-ink rice, shrimp dusted with salt like falling snow, a crab-and-ikura bowl, seared Kobe beef with caviar. Two seatings a night; the chefs explain dishes in several languages, and reviewers praise the friendly head chef and the counter chat. 10% service.

roles: Head chef, not named; operator 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ファイブディアライフ (NTA corporate-number site). October 2026 reviewers praise a friendly head chef who explains each dish, and multilingual service for overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Otoro on squid-ink rice; "snow" salt shrimp; sushi with tempura.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was mesmerised as the chef sprinkled salt over the shrimp like falling snow.
An October 2026 pair of light eaters were glad the last roll could be served as a half portion, and noticed staff explaining the sushi in Chinese to guests from China.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園鮨 琢、寿司・海鮮・うなぎ、東山区清本町352 SAKIZO花見小路ビル 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜22:00 (1部 17:30〜19:30・2部 20:00〜22:00)、年末年始休み (2026年12月31日〜2027年1月4日)、15分以上の遅刻は自動キャンセル、サービス料10%、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル)、禁煙、カード・銀聯・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、インボイス T2120001214766 (株式会社ファイブディアライフ)。口コミ (2026年10〜11月、英語): 寿司と天ぷらのコース12,000円、イカスミと赤酢の黒いシャリ、雪のような塩の海老、蟹といくらの小丼、Kobe 牛とキャビア、多言語の説明。

cultural_comfort.note: Dishes explained in several languages (October 2026); two fixed seatings; 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_gion_shigenaga.gf_detail: Ask when booking. French kaiseki eaten with chopsticks, with consommés, sauces and Japanese ingredients such as yuba; no gluten information is published (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shigenaga.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses use fish, beef, pâté and consommé alongside Kyoto vegetables (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_shigenaga.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last entry 12:30) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last entry 20:00); closed Wednesday and the second Tuesday of each month (Tabelog). Reservation only; the door opens 15 minutes before the booking (October 2025). Service charge 10% (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料10％). 18 seats: a counter of 8 decorated with bonsai and three tatami private rooms (shoes off; up to 8); non-smoking; cards (Tabelog; January 2026). On the 2nd floor of 祇園神聖ビル on Hanamikoji north of Shijo; about 6 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 16 November 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_shigenaga.notes: [French · Gion, French kaiseki with Kyoto vegetables] A second-floor restaurant on Hanamikoji serving French cooking as a kaiseki eaten with chopsticks — Kyoto vegetables, yuba and Japanese fish in consommés and sauces, then poached sea bream or roast beef and a homemade pudding. Counter seats with bonsai, or one of three tatami rooms, good for business lunches. Chef Shigenaga also runs the Kyoto-vegetable French restaurant Lulache. Lunch from about ¥4,800, dinner about ¥12,100, plus 10% service. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef and owner (Tabelog’s official introduction); a December 2023 diner met the chef and the chef’s wife
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: chef Shigenaga, owner of the Kyoto-vegetable French restaurant Lulache in Ogura, Uji, cooks French kaiseki focused on Kyoto vegetables and traditional ingredients, at a counter decorated with bonsai and in private rooms. Opened 16 November 2019 (Tabelog). A December 2023 diner found the chef and the chef’s wife very friendly. Name known only in Latin letters from the English page.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: French kaiseki that catches each seasonal ingredient at its most delicious.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 diner who came just after a typhoon was met by an owner who had worried whether the party could make it.
A September 2026 diner found the cooking leaned so Japanese that it was hard to call French, and lacking novelty, but enjoyed talking with the chef and the owner.
A September 2025 diner found the air conditioning too strong.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京野菜フレンチ懐石 祇園 重なが、フレンチ・日本料理、東山区橋本町398-3 祇園神聖ビル 2F、祇園四条駅から東へ約300m、四条花見小路を北へ約150m、11:30〜14:30 (最終入店12:30)・17:30〜22:00 (最終入店20:00)、水曜と第2火曜休み、完全予約制、サービス料10%、18席 (カウンター8、座敷8)、禁煙、カード可、2019年11月16日オープン、店の紹介 (英語表示): Uji・Ogura の京野菜フレンチ Lulache のオーナー、Shigenaga シェフ、京野菜と伝統の食材、盆栽のカウンター、個室。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): お箸で食べるフレンチ、ランチ4,840円、ディナー12,100円、マスターと奥さん。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; shoes off in the private rooms; 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_hashiya_to_nakase.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, risotto, bruschetta, spring rolls, cutlets and fried dishes fill much of the menu; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hashiya_to_nakase.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly fish, meat and cheese; dishes such as a yam and broccoli aglio e olio or tomato salads may suit, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hashiya_to_nakase.hours_raw: 16:00–22:00 Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). Starter cover ¥300 — a generous salad (Tabelog’s Japanese original: お通し300円; May 2026). Bookings by TableCheck or phone; may be treated as cancelled if 30 minutes late (Tabelog); popular, often full on Fridays (June 2026). 28 seats: a counter of 10 and tables; non-smoking; children welcome, with a high chair and a nappy-changing station; aisles narrow for strollers (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). In a renovated townhouse in a quiet residential lane south of Karasuma-Matsubara; about 5 min from Gojo Stn (TableCheck; 2026 reviews). Opened 26 May 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hashiya_to_nakase.notes: [Izakaya · Gojo, creative Italian-leaning plates] A cosy townhouse izakaya hidden in a residential lane near Gojo, opening at 4 p.m., where a whiteboard of genre-free plates on an Italian base meets plenty of wine and sake: margherita spring rolls, shirasu bruschetta, yodare katsuo, venison cutlet, creamy risottos. Solo diners get smaller portions; families with small children are welcome. ¥300 salad cover. Tabelog Izakaya WEST 'Tabelog 100' 2024. Closed Sunday.

roles: Not named in any source found; a June 2026 diner watched two staff working together
chef_bio.background: Opened 26 May 2022 (Tabelog). Per Tabelog’s official introduction: an izakaya on the theme of "drinks and food", with genre-free creative dishes of seasonal ingredients. Tabelog Izakaya WEST "Tabelog 100" 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Margherita spring rolls; shirasu bruschetta; risotto.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner’s two-year-old tasted the margherita spring roll and exclaimed that it was pizza.
A May 2026 solo diner, ordering before 17:00, was given smaller portions.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ハシヤとナカセ、居酒屋・イタリアン・バル、下京区大江町547-8、五条駅から徒歩約5分、月〜土 16:00〜22:00、日曜・不定休、お通し300円、30分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱いも、28席 (カウンター10、テーブル)、禁煙、子ども可、おむつ台、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、2022年5月26日オープン、居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024。TableCheck: 町家を改装、イタリアンベースに和やアジアの要素、ワインと日本酒、16時から。口コミ (2026年、英語): マルゲリータの春巻き、しらすのブルスケッタ、よだれ鰹、鹿のカツ、リゾット。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ¥300 salad cover; hard to find in a back lane.

existence.note: Tabelog and TableCheck listings; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_tsujifusa.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kyoto kaiseki built on dashi with citrus, vinegar and soy; no gluten information is published (Michelin Guide; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tsujifusa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki of dashi, fish and seafood such as hamo, ayu, crab and soft-shell crab (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tsujifusa.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 Tuesday to Saturday; dinner 18:00–21:30 (last food order 19:30) Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog; Michelin Guide). Reservation only; ask ahead for the private room (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 7 and a private counter room of 5 with sunken seating; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; OMAKASE). Lunch ¥10,000–10,500, dinner about ¥24,000 (OMAKASE; 2026 reviews). The entrance window and counter lights use kumiko woodwork from Okawa, Fukuoka (Michelin Guide). About 6 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 9 May 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsujifusa.notes: [Kaiseki · Marutamachi, a couple's quiet Kyoto counter] A twelve-seat kaiseki counter near the Imperial Palace, opened in May 2024 by chef 辻 義勝 — long trained at Oryori Hayashi and head chef at Aji Fukushima for eleven years — with the okami, a sommelier, pairing sake and wine. The cooking is gentle dashi sharpened with citrus and vinegar: soft-shell crab, hamo and ayu in summer, figs with sesame and matsutake in autumn. Lunch about ¥10,000, dinner about ¥24,000. Listed with a Michelin star soon after opening. Cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef, with the okami (a sommelier and kikisake-shi) — a couple (OMAKASE; July 2025 review)
chef_bio.origin: A hometown known for woodworking, per the Michelin Guide (the kumiko is from Okawa, Fukuoka).
chef_bio.background: Per OMAKASE: 店主 辻義勝 trained for many years at the long-established 御料理はやし, helped launch 味ふくしま and was its head chef for eleven years, then went independent and opened 辻布紗 in May 2024; the okami is a qualified sommelier and kikisake-shi who pairs wine and sake. An August 2026 reviewer adds training at "Yoshiyasu". Per the Michelin Guide: an owner devoted to Kyoto cuisine, attentive to the harmony of ingredients and dashi, using citrus and vinegar for rhythm; the name 布紗 refers to a hemp cloth used in Shinto rites, and plain hemp hangs as the noren. July 2026 reviewers note a Michelin star soon after opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Michelin Guide: deep, nourishing flavour from the harmony of ingredients and dashi, with acidity giving the menu its rise and fall.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest enjoyed the chef’s cooking again for the first time in more than a decade.
An October 2026 diner had a second helping of the matsutake rice and noted overseas guests nearby were also impressed.
A September 2026 group of chatty friends booked the private tatami counter room for five within a ¥15,000 budget with drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: OMAKASE (omakaseje.com): 辻布紗、丸太町駅から徒歩6分の日本料理店、店主の辻義勝氏は老舗の名店「御料理はやし」で長年修行、「味ふくしま」の立ち上げに参加し11年間料理長、2024年5月に独立、ソムリエで利き酒師の資格を持つ女将がワインやお酒を選ぶ、ランチ10,500円、ディナー24,000円。ミシュランガイド: 辻布紗、¥¥¥、中京区百足屋町155、京料理にひたむきに打ち込んできた主人、食材の風味とだしの調和、柑橘や酢の酸味、組子細工は福岡県大川市の伝統工芸、月 18:00–21:30、火〜土 12:00–13:30・18:00–21:30、日曜休み。食べログ: 日本料理、完全予約制、12席 (カウンター7、個室カウンター5)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、2024年5月9日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 夫婦で営む、ミシュラン一つ星、無花果の胡麻和え、松茸。

cultural_comfort.note: Booking only; cash only.

existence.note: Michelin Guide, OMAKASE and Tabelog listings; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_omusubi_sankaku.gf_detail: Ask. Rice balls with fillings such as salt, ume, salmon, marinated tuna, chicken soboro, negi miso and salmon mayo, with miso soup; seasonings may contain wheat; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_omusubi_sankaku.vegan_detail: Ask. Salt, ume and negi-miso rice balls appear, but the miso soup has been a meat-based broth (February 2024) and many fillings are fish or chicken (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_omusubi_sankaku.hours_raw: Tuesday to Friday 8:00–14:00; Saturday and Sunday 8:00–16:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including through Instagram (Tabelog; December 2023); 30-minute seating; book ahead, as the four seats fill and fillings sell out (January–February 2024). Takeaway — ready-made rice balls on a shelf by the door; the shop calls if a takeaway order has a wait (Tabelog; December 2023). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 4 counter seats; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). English menu signs (May 2025). In Gion south of Shijo near Yasaka Shrine; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; January 2024). Opened 17 December 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_omusubi_sankaku.notes: [Onigiri · Gion near Yasaka Shrine, breakfast at four seats] A tiny morning counter in Gion where two cooks shape big, loose rice balls from clay-pot rice to order: salt, ume, marinated tuna, salmon, negi miso. Sit-down sets of two with miso soup are about ¥1,100; rice balls to take away are about ¥350. Four seats and 30-minute sittings, so book (Instagram works) or take away. One 2023 guest found the room too quiet and close for conversation. QR pay, no cards. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 17 December 2022 as a rice-ball shop with breakfast and takeaway. Reviewers describe two male staff shaping rice balls at the counter (December 2023, February 2024), warm and welcoming service (August 2026), and English signage (May 2025); a February 2026 visitor thought it "seems to be run by a couple".
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot rice omusubi; salt and ume.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 customer took four to go and was surprised, on unwrapping, at how big each one was.
"As soon as you take a bite, it crumbles beautifully, releasing the wonderful aroma of the rice." — February 2026.
"It's too quiet to have a conversation, and the staff are quite close by." — September 2023.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おにぎり、東山区祇園町南側533、祇園四条駅から徒歩約7分、火〜金 8:00〜14:00、土・日 8:00〜16:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、4席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子ども可、テイクアウト (待ち時間があれば電話)、朝食、2022年12月17日オープン。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 八坂神社の近く、土鍋で炊いたご飯の大きなおむすび、目の前で握る、イートインは2個と日替わりの味噌汁で1,100円、具によって+50円・+100円、1個350円ほど、塩、梅、漬けまぐろ、鮭、鶏そぼろ、ねぎ味噌、鮭マヨ、肉の出汁の味噌汁、30分制、インスタで予約、男性スタッフ二人、店内が静かで会話しづらいとの声 (2023年9月)、英語の表示。

cultural_comfort.note: English signage (May 2025); point at the fillings; book a seat or take away; QR pay only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_goho_yukke_katamari.gf_detail: GF options on request: the shop's page lists gluten-free among its food-diversity options, and the group's policy says its GF menu excludes wheat, barley, rye and non-GF oats, with seasonings checked against manufacturers' labels. You must tell staff when ordering — the same dish is otherwise served with gluten. Shared kitchen; separate frying oil and pans (official site, 2026).
kyoto_goho_yukke_katamari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a raw-beef specialist — wagyu yukke and steak bowls with egg yolk, ikura and sea urchin (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_goho_yukke_katamari.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30) (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; bookings over 15 minutes late may be cancelled (Tabelog). An otoshi of ¥330 at dinner (Tabelog original ディナー営業、お通し料(330円)). 20 seats at eight two-person tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Cards, iD/QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). Menus in English, Simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog). Muslim-friendly menu with halal-certified wagyu (official site). Second floor of 祇園ヒロビル near Yasaka Shrine; coin parking next door; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 28 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_goho_yukke_katamari.notes: [Yukke bowls · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, raw wagyu] A small second-floor room by Yasaka Shrine from the Oagari group, licensed to serve raw beef: the draw is the temari yukke don — a dome of finely cut black wagyu with egg yolk, ikura optional, finished as dashi chazuke — about ¥2,200–4,100, plus steak boxes and a sea urchin yukke bowl. GF on request (say so when ordering) and a Muslim-friendly menu with halal-certified wagyu. Photogenic; one diner preferred izakaya yukke. ¥330 otoshi at dinner. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a yukke specialist of the Oagari group (おあがりグループ), which also runs 和牛火山おあがり in Arashiyama and Gion and うしとさかな in Sapporo; the group publishes a gluten-free policy and a Muslim-friendly policy (halal-certified wagyu, dedicated utensils, separate storage, staff training) that both name this shop. Per Tabelog: opened 28 March 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Food diversity" — options for allergies, religion and lifestyle so everyone can share a table (official site).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a third visit ate the double yukke bowl with ikura three ways: with the yolk, with condiments, then with the dashi poured over.
"It was tasty, but I think the Yukke at local izakayas might be better." — October 2026.
"Since it was still warm when I visited, it might be better to choose a different season to go." — October 2026, on a faint off-flavour.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (おあがりグループ): 日本初のユッケ専門店 合法ユッケかたまり、黒毛和牛お重、黒毛和牛手毬ユッケ丼 (超極細のカット、赤身とサシの肉をブレンド)、絹トロユッケ (サーロイン)、Food Diversity (グルテンフリー、ハラール対応)、東山区祇園町南側537-2 祇園ヒロビル2F、11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)。グルテンフリーの取り組み: 小麦・大麦・ライ麦・グルテンフリーでないオート麦を使わない、調味料は成分表示を確認、同じ厨房だが揚げ油やフライパンは分ける、注文時に申告が必要。ムスリムフレンドリーの取り組み: ハラール認証の和牛、専用の調理器具、保管を分ける、スタッフ研修。食べログ: 肉バル・丼、毎日営業、予約可 (15分遅れで取消の場合あり)、ディナーはお通し料330円、20席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、子ども可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2025年3月28日オープン。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): 手毬ユッケ丼シングル2,200円、ダブルいくらのせ4,070円、締めは出汁をかけて、生食用食肉の取扱い、写真映え、居酒屋のユッケの方がという声、季節を選んだ方がという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos (Tabelog); tell staff about GF or Muslim-friendly needs when ordering.

gf_cross_contamination.text: The group states gluten-free items are prepared in the same kitchen as dishes containing gluten, with separate frying oil and pans; other equipment is shared but washed before use. Trace cross-contact remains possible.
GF must be requested when ordering: without notice, the same menu item is served with gluten, and the shop takes no responsibility.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The GF policy excludes wheat, barley and rye and says seasoning labels are checked, but does not name the soy sauce used on yukke; standard soy sauce contains wheat, so confirm with staff.

positives.text: The shop page lists gluten-free and halal-friendly options under its "Food Diversity" commitment, and both group policies name Wagyu Steak KATAMARI.

existence.note: Official site (updated October 2026) and Tabelog; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_mughal_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's listing ticks gluten-free options, and basmati rice and many curries are served alongside naan, roti and papad, but no source says which dishes are gluten-free or how gluten-free food is kept apart (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_mughal_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, and the lunch thali comes in vegetarian and non-vegetarian versions with dals, sambar and vegetable curries; confirm ghee and dairy with staff (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_mughal_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:45); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; with children, give the number and ages of the children when booking, or entry may be refused (Tabelog); sometimes closed for private parties (March 2026). 40 seats: 36 at tables, 4 at the counter; private room for 10–20; non-smoking, smoking area by the entrance (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay; QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff; takeaway and delivery; halal and Hindu options listed (Tabelog). Second floor of アイル竹島ビル on Kiyamachi north of Oike, up an apartment-style stair; 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Founded 1987 (January 2026 review).
kyoto_mughal_kiyamachi.notes: [Indian · Kiyamachi above Oike, since 1987] A spacious second-floor Indian restaurant on Kiyamachi, open since 1987 and trusted by locals — one reviewer's Indian colleague called it the best curry ever. The lunch "Full Thali" (¥2,530, vegetarian or not) brings rasam, four curries, tikka and naan; two-curry sets start at ¥1,100, and biryani appears at weekends. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and Hindu options are listed; English spoken. Fast service. Open late. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2026 regular says the restaurant was founded in 1987 and is among the most trusted in the area. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a spacious room with rich decor, well-mannered staff and very fast service; Tabelog lists English-speaking staff.
chef_bio.specialty: The Full Thali; biryani; daily vegetable curry.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor came on the repeated recommendation of an Indian colleague who called it the best curry ever eaten, India included.
A March 2026 guest, turned away once by a private party, returned on a weekday and was surprised by a lightly cooked spinach-and-potato curry.
"The sweet potato soup was almost entirely garlic-flavored. It was a valuable spice experience." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: インド料理・インドカレー・ワインバー、中京区木屋町御池上ル アイル竹島ビル2F、市役所前駅から徒歩5分、昼 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜 18:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.22:00、ドリンクL.O.22:45)、火曜休み、予約可 (子連れは人数と年齢を予約時に)、40席 (テーブル36、カウンター4)、個室10〜20名、禁煙 (入口近くに喫煙所)、カード (銀聯も)・QR (Alipay も) 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、テイクアウト・デリバリー、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー・ハラール・ヒンドゥーの選択肢あり。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 1987年創業、2種カレーのランチ1,100円、フルターリー2,530円、週末のビリヤニセット1,760円、ほうれん草とじゃがいものカレー、マトン、ダール、サンバル、ビンダルー、タンドリーチキン、シークカバブ、キングフィッシャー900円、インド人の同僚が人生最高と、料理が出るのが速い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); mention children when booking; cards and QR.

kyoto_gion_karyo.gf_detail: Ask. Monthly kaiseki courses with dashi, white and red miso, soy-based sauces and clay-pot rice; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_karyo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki courses of fish, crab, oysters, duck and dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_karyo.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00, last order 19:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — and needed (Tabelog; July 2026). A 10% service charge from 1 November to 8 December 2026 (Tabelog original 2026/11/1〜12/8までの期間中サービス料10%頂戴いたします). A seasonal course changing monthly, about ¥15,000–20,000 in reviews (Tabelog). 38 seats: a 14-seat counter and a private room on the ground floor, table seating for 2–10 upstairs, one private and two semi-private rooms; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; children welcome, kids' menu (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). Dishes explained in English (December 2025; July 2026). On Hanamikoji directly opposite the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_karyo.notes: [Kaiseki · Hanamikoji, opposite the Kaburenjo] A long-established kaiseki house on Hanamikoji facing the Gion Kobu Kaburenjo, with a 14-seat counter where you watch the sashimi cut and the kamado rice cooked, and private rooms upstairs. Monthly courses of about ¥15,000–20,000 end with a choice of clay-pot rice — chirimen sansho or shirasu and mentaiko. Warm, unhurried service, with dishes explained in English; reviewers call it good value for Gion. 10% service from 1 Nov to 8 Dec 2026. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seasonal course changing monthly, cherishing the traditions of Japanese cuisine while exploring new techniques and ingredients, with rice and sashimi prepared at the counter. A July 2026 regular since 2019 has watched the chefs grow and heard that one early chef has opened a Kyoto-kaiseki restaurant in Milan; a June 2026 family returned after several decades to find it unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: Tradition and innovation in Japanese cuisine (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I often see the staff patiently explaining the dishes in English to foreign customers, and watching that is one of my personal joys of coming here." — July 2026.
A June 2026 family, back after several decades, found the interior and exterior unchanged — and chose the chirimen and mentaiko rice from three.
A December 2025 guest celebrated finishing a project with friends from Germany at the long counter, with each dish explained in English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園町南側 祇園甲部歌舞練場前、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、花見小路を入って歌舞練場の正面、月・火・木〜日 18:00〜22:00 (L.O.19:30)、水曜休み、予約可、2026年11月1日〜12月8日はサービス料10%、38席 (1階カウンター14、個室1、2階テーブル)、個室1・半個室2、禁煙、Wi-Fi、子ども可・キッズメニュー、カード可、月替わりの季節のコース、伝統と新しい技法、かまどのご飯とお造りを目の前で。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 柚子釜、白味噌のお椀、八寸、しらすと明太子の土鍋ご飯、ちりめん山椒と卵黄の丼、3種から選ぶ炊き込みご飯、毛蟹、鱧、ひらめ、牡蠣、鮎寿司、鴨、英語で料理の説明、ミラノで京懐石を開いた元料理人の話、数十年ぶりでも変わらない。

cultural_comfort.note: Dishes explained in English (2025–2026 reviews); book ahead; 10% service 1 Nov–8 Dec 2026; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with a service-charge notice for November–December 2026; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_kocha_club_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Tea with scones, cakes (mille-feuille, Mont Blanc, petit cakes) and fresh tagliatelle; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kocha_club_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. Teas are plain leaf or flavoured; the pasta (carbonara, basil with steamed chicken) and cakes use egg, dairy or meat (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kocha_club_gojo.hours_raw: 11:00–17:00; closed Tuesday and the second Monday of each month (open that Monday for reservations; third Monday if the second is a holiday) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 10 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Tea leaves, sweets and tea cosies to take away; some sweets are made by people with disabilities (Tabelog shop text). On Kaki-machi-dori by Rokuharamitsu-ji, 3 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo exit 5 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kocha_club_gojo.notes: [Kissa · Kiyomizu-Gojo, a one-man tea room] A ten-seat tea specialist near Rokuharamitsu-ji, run single-handed by a kind, elderly owner who explains every tea. Pick your own cup and pot cosy from the shelves, then a Darjeeling-Assam blend or a fruit tea with crisp scones, cake, or the fresh-pasta lunch set. Blankets on the chairs in winter; tea leaves and sweets to take home, some made by people with disabilities. Closed Tuesday and the second Monday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who runs the shop alone
chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer describes the shop as run single-handed by a kind elderly gentleman; a January 2026 regular has come for about fifteen years. A July 2024 reviewer describes the owner as supporting children with disabilities, and the shop’s Tabelog text says some sweets on sale are made by people with disabilities. A November 2024 reviewer heard it is loved by Kyoto’s geiko and maiko.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor came in from the snow to find blankets on the seats, and had the owner explain the teas before choosing a cup from the shelf.
An October 2026 visitor found it full with three groups at 1:30 on a weekday, bought 100 g of the strawberry-and-peach Ichigo Ichie blend in a pouch of choice, and resolved to book next time.
A September 2025 visitor noticed the floor by the entrance table sloped slightly.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 紅茶倶楽部、喫茶店、東山区柿町通大黒町西入東川原町508、清水五条駅5番出口から徒歩3分、11:00〜17:00、火曜と第2月曜休み (予約があれば営業)、予約可、カード・PayPay可、10席、禁煙、茶葉、お菓子 (障がいのある方が作った商品も)、ティーコジーの販売、ブログ。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 年配の店主がひとりで営む、棚からカップを選べる、ヌワラエリヤとスコーン約1,200〜1,300円、Afternoon Tea Blend 1、Ichigo Ichie (いちごと桃)、スコーン、ミルフィーユ、モンブラン、パスタと紅茶とデザートのセット (タリアテッレ)、芸妓さん舞妓さんにも愛される。

cultural_comfort.note: Ten seats, often full; reservations accepted; the owner explains the teas.

kyoto_s_vietnam_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Pho uses rice noodles and fresh spring rolls rice paper, but banh mi is wheat bread and fried spring rolls and sauces are not described for gluten (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_s_vietnam_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the reviewed dishes use chicken, shrimp and fish sauce (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_s_vietnam_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 daily; dinner 17:00–22:00 Monday–Thursday, 17:00–23:00 Friday–Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 28 seats; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and power outlets; children welcome (Tabelog). Two staff at lunch (July 2025). Second floor of the MIYUKI building on Kiyamachi south of Oike, the lift opening straight into the restaurant; 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 7 June 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_s_vietnam_kiyamachi.notes: [Vietnamese · Kiyamachi-Oike, pho and banh mi upstairs] A small, cheerfully decorated Vietnamese restaurant one floor up on Kiyamachi near Oike — the lift opens straight into the room. Lunch is the draw: the ¥1,200 Special S set brings half a pho, both kinds of spring rolls, a mini rice bowl, salad and che; or pair homemade banh mi with half a pho. Evenings run to beer and small plates. Seasoning is mild — add fish sauce at the table. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 7 June 2023; the shop’s text says the name comes from Vietnam’s S-shaped map. A July 2025 reviewer found two staff running lunch.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner, drawn by high Google reviews despite a low Tabelog score, found the seasoning toned down for Japanese tastes and added plenty of fish sauce.
A February 2026 regular of a nearby Thai restaurant tried Vietnamese for a change and nearly walked past the street-level menu board.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: エスベトナム料理、ベトナム料理、中京区上大阪515 MIYUKIビル2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩1分、昼11:00〜15:00、夜17:00〜22:00 (金〜日祝は23:00まで)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、28席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、電源、子ども可、テイクアウト、2023年6月7日オープン、店名はベトナムのS字の形から。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): スペシャルSセット1,200円 (ハーフのフォー、生春巻き、揚げ春巻き、ミニ丼、サラダ、チェー、えびせん)、バインミーとハーフフォーのセット1,200〜1,300円、えびの生春巻き420円、ハノイの揚げ春巻き490円、サイゴンビール、味はやさしめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Upstairs, lift opens into the room; reviewers note many guests from abroad (June 2025).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_point_pour_point_fuchomae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery and cake shop of wheat breads, croissants, tarts and pies (2026 reviews).
kyoto_point_pour_point_fuchomae.vegan_detail: Ask. Croissants, tarts, cakes and filled breads use butter, cream, cheese or meat; the lean breads such as the 48-hour baguette are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_point_pour_point_fuchomae.hours_raw: 10:00–18:30, Wednesday–Sunday; closed Monday and Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (cakes, celebrations) (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Takeaway; seats not listed (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No parking; coin parking nearby (July 2026). Near the Kyoto Prefectural Office and the Imperial Palace, 5 min from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; July–August 2026).
kyoto_point_pour_point_fuchomae.notes: [Bakery · Prefectural Office, mentaiko bread and apple pie] A busy bakery-pâtisserie near the Kyoto Prefectural Office and the Imperial Palace, which an August 2026 regular says turned from a cake shop into a bakery. Regulars name the mentaiko French bread and the thin-sliced apple pie first; there are also croissants (¥270 before tax), fig breads, a 48-hour baguette, savoury twists such as takuan with bonito, and cakes in the case. PayPay but no cards; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Not stated in the sources read. The shop name 府庁前店 implies another shop, but none was found.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor came for the mentaiko French bread, found it not yet out of the oven, waited, and went straight home with it.
A July 2026 regular, who ranks it in a personal Kyoto top five, always buys the sausage breads.

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway bakery; PayPay but no cards.

kyoto_actual_kyoto_mibu.gf_detail: Ask. Specialty coffee with cheesecakes (classic Basque, matcha, chocolate, seasonal lemon); whether the cheesecakes contain flour is not stated (2023 article; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_actual_kyoto_mibu.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee suits; the cheesecakes, lattes and gelato use dairy (2023 article; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_actual_kyoto_mibu.hours_raw: Tabelog: 10:00–18:00, closed Tuesday; hours may change. A July 2023 rurubu article gave Wednesday–Thursday 10:00–18:00, Friday–Sunday 11:00–18:00, evenings on Friday and Saturday, closed Monday and Tuesday. No reservations; queues — about an hour at 15:00 in October 2026; a July 2026 reviewer met unexpected closures (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cash, cards (VISA, Master), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats over two floors; a terrace where pets are allowed (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Beside the Randen Arashiyama line, 4 min from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 14 April 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_actual_kyoto_mibu.notes: [Café · Shijo-Omiya, cheesecake by the Randen tracks] A machiya over a century old, opened up with concrete and old beams, right beside the Randen tram line near Shijo-Omiya — ask for a window seat upstairs and watch the trains pass. The order is specialty coffee (an Ethiopian medium roast is popular) with a cheesecake: classic Basque, matcha or a seasonal flavour, about ¥1,300 as a set. Expect a queue, sometimes an hour; pets welcome on the terrace. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owners 北浦夫妻 (a married couple), per rurubu
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2023 rurubu article: opened in April 2023 by the owners, the 北浦 couple, in a renovated machiya over 100 years old. Tabelog gives the opening as 14 April 2023.
chef_bio.philosophy: The name ACTUAL reflects a wish to value the place and time — that people actually come here on purpose, or meet someone here (rurubu, July 2023).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 pair joined a queue of about ten at 3 p.m., got in after 4, and landed the upstairs window table right above the Randen tracks.
A July 2026 visitor had been turned away twice by unexpected closures before finally getting in, and found the lemon in the seasonal cheesecake a little faint.
A September 2026 visitor warns that service can be slow when busy, so allow extra time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: るるぶ&more (2023年7月): ACTUAL KYOTO、2023年4月に四条大宮にオープンしたスペシャルティコーヒーとチーズケーキの店、オーナーは北浦夫妻、店名は「実際に、ここを目指して来ていただいたり、人と待ち合わせしたり」という場所や時間を大切にしたい思いから、築100年を超える町家をリノベーション、ドリップコーヒー650円、カフェラテ650円、抹茶ラテ750円、クラシックバスクチーズケーキ800円、抹茶チーズケーキ800円、セット1,300円、当時は月・火休み。食べログ: 中京区壬生賀陽御所町20-2、阪急大宮駅から徒歩4分、10:00〜18:00、火曜休み、予約不可、現金・カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、20席、テラスはペット可、2023年4月14日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 嵐電の線路沿い、2階の窓から電車、エチオピア、レモンのバスクチーズケーキ、ジェラート、行列、臨時休業。

cultural_comfort.note: Queues, no reservations; staff help choose beans; many visitors from abroad (October 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.
