kyoto_maimaian_gion.gf_detail: Ask. The onigiri themselves are rice, but fillings, oden, miso soups and many side dishes use soy and dashi, and there are fried dishes (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_maimaian_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan as a whole: most fillings are fish or meat, and the soups and oden use dashi (2024–26 reviews). A plain "shiro" onigiri exists — ask.
kyoto_maimaian_gion.hours_raw: 19:00–4:00; closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; fills up after midnight (Tabelog; September 2025). 13 seats at an L-shaped counter (Tabelog; January 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners only); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). East of Hanamikoji, Gion; 322 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_maimaian_gion.notes: [Onigiri & izakaya · Gion, rice balls till 4 a.m.] A small L-shaped counter east of Hanamikoji where Gion's night ends: bite-size onigiri of Uonuma Koshihikari — about 20 fillings at around ¥150 each — with red miso or pork miso soup, dashimaki and, in winter, oden. Come early for drinks and sashimi, or after midnight when it fills up. Smoking allowed. 19:00–4:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: onigiri made with Uonuma Koshihikari rice and water from Echigo. Reviewers describe a quiet master shaping the rice balls at the counter (November 2025), many regulars and a welcome for travellers (May 2024), and a shop open for several years (April 2025).

anecdotes.text: A December 2023 diner loved the onigiri but found the fried taro too salty.
"Isn’t JPY 150 for an onigiri incredibly cheap? I wonder if prices have gone up due to inflation now..." — March 2024.
A September 2025 diner arrived about 1 a.m. and was seated at once; within 30 minutes the counter was full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (maimaian.com): 京都 祇園 米々庵 (まいまいあん)、魚沼産こしひかりと越後の名水を使ったおにぎり。食べログ: 日本料理・おにぎり、東山区花見小路富永町東入ル ゴールドビル1F、祇園四条駅から322m、月〜土 19:00〜翌4:00、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、13席、喫煙可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年1月、英語): 小さなおにぎり約20種、1個150円 (2024年)、だし巻き500円、赤だし400円、冬のおでん5品1,000円、鶏むねのチーズカツ600円、L字のカウンター、深夜に満席、里芋の唐揚げが塩辛かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order onigiri by filling at the counter; JCB, AMEX or Diners only; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through January 2026.

kyoto_maimaian_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26013442/ (35.004370, 135.775311); the address has no lot number and GSI resolves only the town 京都府京都市東山区富永町 (94 m away), so the pin stays on the Tabelog point; 2026-11-05

kyoto_common_well.gf_detail: Ask. Breakfast plates come with toast and baguette, and the cakes and tarts are baked; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_common_well.vegan_detail: A September 2026 diner found a solid vegan menu, with vegan butter for the bread; soy and oat milk are offered for coffee (December 2024; September 2026).
kyoto_common_well.hours_raw: 7:00–22:00 daily, open year-round: breakfast 7:00–11:30, lunch 11:30–15:00, café 15:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–22:00 (last orders food 20:30, drinks 21:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料、チャージ料なし」). 33 seats — counter, a big shared table, tables and a low table — and a terrace; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards and IC cards (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner also paid by QR. The café of HOTEL RINGS KYOTO, next door; on Sakaimachi-dori south of Rokkaku, near Nishiki Market; 7 min from Karasuma Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 28 September 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_common_well.notes: [Café · Nishiki area, Melbourne coffee from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.] The café of HOTEL RINGS KYOTO, a bright space round a big wooden table near Nishiki Market, serving Melbourne-style coffee made to your spec — flat white, long black, decaf, soy or oat milk — under a world latte-art champion's direction. A hearty breakfast plate (¥2,300) from 7:00, cakes all day, and a calm late café until 22:00. A vegan menu too. No service charge.

roles: Hotel café; coffee produced by a champion barista (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the café of HOTEL RINGS KYOTO, with Melbourne-style specialty coffee produced by a barista who twice won the world latte-art championship, placed at world championships five years running, and produced ten cafés in Melbourne over seven years. Opened 28 September 2021 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner liked the breakfast plate but found the moromi-miso salad dressing a little salty.
A September 2026 diner found the fig cream latte low on fig flavour but enjoyable for the mascarpone and espresso.
A latte and chocolate gâteau came to about ¥1,200 — good value for Kyoto, an October 2026 diner felt.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hotel-rings.com/cafe): メルボルンスタイルのスペシャリティコーヒー、豆の種類や抽出方法、ミルクの量や温度、泡の質感までカスタマイズ、ラテアート世界大会で2度優勝し、メルボルンで7年間に10店舗のカフェをプロデュースしたバリスタ。食べログ: カフェ、中京区堺町通六角下る甲屋町393、烏丸駅から徒歩7分、毎日7:00〜22:00 (朝食7:00〜11:30、ランチ11:30〜15:00、カフェ15:00〜18:00、ディナー18:00〜22:00)、年中無休、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、33席、貸切20名まで、カード・交通系IC可、2021年9月28日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年10月、英語): フラットホワイト、デカフェ、豆乳とオーツミルク、レギュラープレート2,300円、キャロットケーキ、ヴィーガンメニュー、海外の客が多い、ドレッシングがやや塩辛いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order coffee to your spec at the counter; cards and IC cards; many international guests.

positives.text: A September 2026 diner found a solid vegan menu, with vegan butter served for the bread.

existence.note: Official hotel site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_common_well.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26036506/ (35.006549, 135.763449); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区甲屋町393番地 (lot) 26m; 2026-11-05

kyoto_toriyasa.gf_detail: Ask. Mizutaki in a chicken-bone broth with house-made ponzu and grilled mochi, finished as zosui or chicken soba; courses add sushi and fried fish (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_toriyasa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken mizutaki house; the broth is boiled from chicken bones (Tabelog).
kyoto_toriyasa.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–16:00 (last food order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last food order 20:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; official site). Reservation only (Tabelog); a same-day set menu may be offered on arrival (October 2026). Not suitable for guests under 18 (Tabelog). Lunch ¥4,800 with one drink — chicken soba or chicken zosui after broth and appetizers (May and September 2026); dinner mizutaki courses about ¥15,000–30,000 a head (2026 reviews). 30 seats with a counter facing a small garden, private rooms for 2–8, and riverside seating by the Kamo in summer (Tabelog; May–July 2026). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). English-speaking staff (October 2026). By the Kamo River south of Shijo; 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_toriyasa.notes: [Mizutaki · Kamo riverside, since 1788] A mizutaki house founded in 1788 by the Kamo River south of Shijo, in a heritage building with a garden-view counter, private rooms and summer riverside seats. The rich white chicken broth, boiled from bones, is the point — sip it first, cook the chicken in it, and finish with zosui. Lunch, newly added after a recent renovation, is ¥4,800 with a drink; dinner courses run about ¥15,000–30,000. Reservation only; adults only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Long-running family house (unnamed); an October 2026 diner heard it has passed to the ninth generation
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1788, it began as a poultry shop opened by the first-generation 彌助; the second generation, 彌三郎, began serving chicken dishes upstairs, and the building has kept its appearance since the founding. Tabelog’s shop text says the mizutaki was loved by Sakamoto Ryoma. Reviewers note a recent renovation and the start of lunch (May and July 2026), and an October 2026 diner heard the business had passed to the ninth generation.
chef_bio.specialty: Mizutaki in a white chicken broth; zosui.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner in a yukata, kept off the riverside by the weather, ate the mizutaki in a cool tatami room; the broth is simmered for three days.
A September 2026 diner contrasted it with Hakata mizutaki: this one uses chicken breast.
A July 2026 lunch guest was served iced hojicha in a wine glass and a taste of the broth before choosing soba or zosui (Japanese review).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (toriyasa.jp): 創業天明八年 (1788年)、木屋町の水炊き料亭、初代彌助の「かしわ屋」が起源、二代目彌三郎が店でさばいた鶏で二階で鶏料理を出し始めた、創業以来変わらない建物、昼 11:00〜16:00・夜 17:00〜22:00。食べログ: 水炊き・鶏料理・日本料理、下京区西石垣通四条下ル斉藤町136、京都河原町駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、火・水曜休み、完全予約制、18歳未満は不向き、30席、個室 2〜8名、夏は納涼の席、禁煙、カード可、登録有形文化財、Sakamoto Ryoma が愛した水炊き、白濁スープ、焼き餅とポン酢は自家製、締めの雑炊。口コミ (2026年5〜10月): 昼4,800円 (鶏そばか雑炊、1ドリンク)、改装してランチを開始、川沿いの席、Daisen 鶏の皮せんべい、夜のコース、九代目に代替わりしたという声、英語が通じる。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; staff speak good English and explain the course; adults only.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_bron_ronnery.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant asks for allergies and dietary needs at reservation (Tabelog). Courses include bread with refills, soups and desserts (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bron_ronnery.vegan_detail: Ask when booking (Tabelog). Courses feature Kyoto vegetables but are built around fish and meat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bron_ronnery.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:00), daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; give allergies and dietary needs when booking (Tabelog). Dinner "Menu Ronronne" of 11 dishes ¥15,730 (Tabelog); lunch courses about ¥3,000–5,000, a 5-dish short course, and a fish-and-meat lunch (2026 reviews). Private room with a sunken kotatsu and garden view for 4, ¥1,100 (Tabelog; August 2026). 40 seats (36 at tables) on the basement floor of the hotel THE SCREEN (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Near the Imperial Palace; 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi and Marutamachi Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_bron_ronnery.notes: [French · near the Imperial Palace, Kyoto-style French in a design hotel] The basement restaurant of the design hotel THE SCREEN, where chef Yasumasa Nakahira serves Kyoto-vegetable French to eat with chopsticks, in a room painted by Tetsuei Nakamura. Lunch courses (about ¥3,000–5,000) are good value; the 11-dish dinner is ¥15,730. Book the garden-view kotatsu room (¥1,100) and ask for a message plate — the pastry work is the talk of reviews. Service can be patchy. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto-style French in a Japanese space painted by the artist Tetsuei Nakamura, with seasonal ingredients on distinctive tableware, eaten with chopsticks; the 11-dish Menu Ronronne is by chef Yasumasa Nakahira. The hotel THE SCREEN is run by 株式会社トレーダー愛 (official site). Reviewers single out a pastry chef for the dessert plates (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner had to point out that the bread never reached one of three guests.
A June 2026 diner liked the seasoning and the tender steak but found the portions small for men.
A June 2026 diner, there for a birthday, called the message plate the best artwork ever seen on one.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (screen-hotel.jp): ホテル THE SCREEN、運営会社は株式会社トレーダー愛。食べログ: フレンチ・ステーキ、中京区下御霊前町640-1 THE SCREEN 内、神宮丸太町駅・丸太町駅から徒歩5分、昼 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 13:30)・夜 17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 20:00)、予約可、アレルギーは予約時に、夜の Menu Ronronne 11品15,730円 (シェフ Yasumasa Nakahira)、40席、掘りごたつの個室 (4名、1,100円)、カード・PayPay 可、画家 Tetsuei Nakamura の空間で箸で食べる京風フレンチ。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): ホテルの地下、昼のコース約3,000〜5,000円、京都中央市場の魚、Miyazaki の牛肉、メッセージプレートが見事、パンが一人に来なかったという声、量が少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; give allergies when booking; cards and PayPay.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The restaurant asks guests to give food allergies and dietary needs when booking.

existence.note: Official hotel site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_hyakusai_gyuniku_men.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: hand-pulled wheat noodles and gyoza (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_hyakusai_gyuniku_men.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-bone broth, beef, lamb and dumplings (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_hyakusai_gyuniku_men.hours_raw: 11:00–21:00 daily, open all year (official site; Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). The shop serves no pork dishes, per its Tabelog text. Mobile ordering (June 2026). 39 seats over two floors; English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; children welcome; takeaway and delivery; BYO allowed; non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). On the south side of the Sanjo shopping street just off Kawaramachi; 8 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn exit 7 (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_hyakusai_gyuniku_men.notes: [Beef noodles · Sanjo off Kawaramachi] Lanzhou and Taiwanese beef noodles with noodles hand-pulled to order in your choice of eight shapes — about ¥1,000–1,100 a bowl — plus lamb dumplings, sesame tripe and douhua for dessert. No pork dishes. Multilingual menus, mobile ordering, open daily 11:00–21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator: a beef-noodle specialist where skilled cooks hand-pull the noodles after you order. The official site lists this single shop. A June 2026 regular has eaten its beef noodles since a former location in Fukakusa before the pandemic.

anecdotes.text: A diner who lived in Taiwan for six months forty years ago came for the Taiwanese beef noodles — June 2026.
An April 2026 lunch guest chose the wide flat noodles and found them broader than expected, almost knife-cut.
On a staff recommendation, a June 2026 business traveller paired beer with the sesame honeycomb tripe — "incredibly delicious".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hyakusai-beefnoodles.com): 百歳牛肉麺 三条河原町店、中京区石橋町14-14、毎日11:00〜21:00、蘭州牛肉麺1,000円、牛肉担々麺1,000円、旨辛牛肉混ぜ麺1,050円、台湾牛肉麺1,100円、酸菜牛肉麺1,100円、焼き餃子・揚げ物、羊料理、台湾甘味。食べログ (店舗会員): ラーメン・中華・居酒屋、京阪三条駅7番出口から徒歩8分、年中無休、予約不可、39席、注文後に手打ちする8種の麺、豚肉料理はなし、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、テイクアウト・デリバリー、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年1〜9月、英語): 蘭州牛肉麺980円、台湾牛肉麺、羊の餃子、ハチノスの胡麻和え、豆花、モバイルオーダー、以前は Fukakusa にあった。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; English- and Chinese-speaking staff; mobile ordering (Tabelog; 2026).

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_yoshokuya_nakago.gf_detail: Ask. Demi-glace hamburg, breaded cutlets, gratin and pasta; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_yoshokuya_nakago.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, pork, prosciutto, pâté and shrimp (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_yoshokuya_nakago.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:30–21:00, last seating 20:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer says lunch has stopped and only dinner is served; earlier lunch sets (hamburg set ¥2,200 in January and April 2026) are no longer offered. Bookings taken — one diner booked by phone a month ahead (May 2026); no photos of the menu (April 2026). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; cards and e-money (Tabelog). At the back of "Momiji no Koji", a machiya alley off Matsubara-dori; 7 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_yoshokuya_nakago.notes: [Yoshoku · Momiji no Koji off Matsubara] An eight-seat counter at the back of a renovated machiya alley, cooking classic Western-style dishes — a hamburg steak in long-simmered demi-glace, cabbage rolls — alongside wine-friendly small plates. Dinner only since 2026; about ¥8,000–10,000 with drinks. Regulars fill it: book. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed; a May 2026 reviewer describes a husband-and-wife team)
chef_bio.background: Opened 27 July 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer heard stories about the owner's work in New York; a May 2026 reviewer says it appears to be run by a husband-and-wife team, the husband cooking quietly and the wife serving.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch guest found the service "quite unfriendly", while regulars were greeted with conversation — "a nostalgic feel reminiscent of Kyoto from decades ago".
A May 2026 diner booked by phone a month ahead and found the counter full of chatting regulars.
Returning in September 2026, a guest found lunch discontinued and the evening menu richer in drinks and appetizers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食屋 なかご、洋食、下京区松原通御幸町西入ル石不動之町682-2 もみじの小路 H-8、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩7分、火〜日 17:30〜21:00 (最終入店20:00)、月曜休み、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙、2023年7月27日オープン。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): デミグラスのハンバーグ、ロールキャベツ、トンカツ、ポークジンジャー、ナポリタン、ランチのハンバーグ定食2,200円 (のちにランチ終了)、生ハムのサラダ、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、鰹のたたき、海老グラタン、メニューの撮影不可、夫婦で営む様子、ニューヨークでの仕事の話。

cultural_comfort.note: A small counter of regulars; book by phone; no menu photos.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_yoshokuya_nakago.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26039891/ (34.998723, 135.765927); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市下京区石不動之町682番地 (lot) 15m; 22.5 m from kyoto_sashimi_maru in the same alley; 2026-11-05

kyoto_ihoto_fufu.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Gozen sets with tempura, charcoal-grilled skewers, miso soup and many small dishes; a July 2026 reviewer says allergies were catered for well; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ihoto_fufu.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: sashimi, chicken and fish skewers, and an Ihoto soup with pork (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ihoto_fufu.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30) daily (Tabelog). Bookings advised; the tempura gozen can be ordered on the day (September 2026). Enter by the restaurant's own entrance, left of the ryokan Fufu Kyoto's north front along the stone path (Tabelog) — a January 2026 guest was sent round to the hotel entrance instead. No lunch parking (Tabelog). 46 seats incl. a counter facing the garden and private rooms; English menu; children welcome with kids' menu; wheelchair accessible; smoking area; cards and QR (Tabelog). By Nanzen-ji; 7 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_ihoto_fufu.notes: [Ryokan lunch · Nanzen-ji] The garden restaurant of the luxury ryokan Fufu Kyoto, open to non-guests at lunch: gozen trays of Kyoto vegetables, tempura and charcoal-grilled skewers (about ¥3,800–5,800) in quiet, screened seats over the garden. Use the restaurant's own side entrance; book ahead. Open daily for lunch.

roles: Restaurant of the ryokan Fufu Kyoto (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 April 2023 (Tabelog), as the restaurant of Fufu Kyoto, a small luxury ryokan by Nanzen-ji with a garden fed by the Lake Biwa Canal (2026 reviews). A January 2026 guest describes Ihoto as the ryokan's main dining room, also serving its breakfast. Lunch is open to non-guests (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 lunch guest found the service on the gozen "rather careless" for a hotel of this calibre.
The waiting area is laid out so that guests do not cross paths — July 2026, when allergies were also handled well.
After Nanzen-ji, a March 2026 visitor had the charcoal gozen of chicken and fish skewers while gazing at the garden.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 京野菜と炭火料理 庵都、日本料理、左京区南禅寺草川町41、蹴上駅から徒歩約7分、毎日11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)、ふふ 京都の北側の正面に向かって左の石畳から専用の入口、ランチ用の駐車場なし、46席、個室、英語メニュー、子供可、ホテルのレストラン、2023年4月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): Fukushige 膳 (小鉢9品、天ぷら、ご飯、庵都の汁、甘味)、天ぷら御膳3,800円、炭火焼き御膳5,800円、日本庭園を望むカウンター、白味噌の味噌汁、アレルギー対応、朝食も庵都で。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book ahead; use the restaurant's own entrance.

staff_allergy_handling: A July 2026 reviewer says allergy concerns were catered for perfectly.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through October 2026. The ryokan's lunch page returned HTTP 503 on 2026-11-05.

kyoto_comme_ci_comme_ca.gf_detail: Ask when booking. A French omakase with bread, a venison pie and a curry or cheese finale; no gluten information (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_comme_ci_comme_ca.vegan_detail: Not vegan: foie gras, fish, eel, venison and black wagyu (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_comme_ci_comme_ca.hours_raw: Lunch Thu–Sun from 12:00 (last entry), closing 15:00; dinner Wed–Sun 17:30–21:30, last entry 18:30; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservation only, from about two months ahead (Tabelog). 6 seats, up to 4 per group; children 12 and over; no very casual clothes (beach sandals, geta, shorts); no flash photography; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). A house in an alley in Okazaki; by the Okazaki Park and Zoo bus stop (buses 5, 32, 100) (Tabelog; April 2024).
kyoto_comme_ci_comme_ca.notes: [French · a house in Okazaki] A six-seat French restaurant in a hidden house near the Okazaki zoo, where the hostess's warm welcome is as famous as the cooking — ten courses with Japanese touches, ending in a choice of curry or cheese. About ¥15,000–20,000; wine pairings. Reservation only, two months ahead; 12 and over. Closed Monday–Tuesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), with a hostess ("Madam") who runs the room (2024–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 27 May 2015 (Tabelog). Reviews from 2023 to 2026 describe a madam who greets and serves, and an owner remembered as "warm and wonderful" (June 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: French omakase with a curry or cheese finale.

anecdotes.text: A six-time regular in June 2023 sensed a return to Japanese influences — dashi jellies and Dentaku anago — as foie gras grew expensive.
For a February 2025 birthday, the madam took many photos with the birthday plate.
A July 2025 couple had stayed away two years after price rises but found it worth it for a birthday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): コムシコムサ、フレンチ、左京区岡崎法勝寺町124-4、市バス「岡崎公園 動物園前」すぐ、昼 木〜日 12:00 (最終入店)〜15:00、夜 水〜日 17:30〜18:30 (最終入店)〜21:30、月火休み、完全予約制 (約2か月前から)、6席 (1組4名まで)、12歳以上、ラフすぎる服装は不可、フラッシュ撮影不可、2015年5月27日オープン。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年5月、英語・日本語): マダムの温かいもてなし、10品のコース、雲丹、鰻、黒毛和牛、鹿のパイ、締めはカレーかチーズ、ワインのペアリング、一皿の量が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book about two months ahead; small groups of up to four.

existence.note: Tabelog listing kept by the shop; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_comme_ci_comme_ca.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26001089/ (35.013859, 135.785742); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市左京区岡崎法勝寺町124番地 (lot) 92m; 2026-11-05
